label: Household net worth
definition: Value of all assets a household or family owns (homes, retirement accounts, businesses, financial and other assets) minus all its debts, measured for the household as a unit and grouped by the age of the head of household.
phrasings: median net worth of American households by age
how much are retirees worth on average
median net worth for 65 year olds
what net worth puts my household in the top 10%
family net worth by age of head
